newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - IMAX rated outperform.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - IMAX rated outperform.

text.p: Everen Securities said Friday it began coverage of IMAX Corp with an outperform rating.

-- In a report, Everen said it expects the company will continue to show long-term earnings growth in excess of 30 percent as a result of the continued expansion of its theater network. IMAX has 165 theater systems in operation throughout the world, Everen said, adding it expects the number of units to increase to more than 400 over the next five years.
-- IMAX shares on the NASDAQ were up 5/8 at 22-3/4.
-- Earnings estimates for IMAX are $0.69 a share in fiscal 1997 and $0.95 in 1998.
